source_evidence: Depending on how the fund is structured, you will need to be an accredited investor or qualified purchaser to invest in hedge funds.
answer: Hedge funds are generally limited to investors who meet certain financial or sophistication criteria. Depending on how a fund is structured, an investor must qualify as either an accredited investor or a qualified purchaser. The source describes these categories generally as requiring a certain level of income or assets, or meeting other professional criteria; it does not provide specific thresholds.
